[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-nh[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Intentions, summary, and reflection on every day and period, shown [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]in an intention card[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every canonical daily note and every week, quarter, and year note [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]carries the same three hidden frontmatter fields: `intentions` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](Bryan's list), `summary` (an agent's short account of what [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]happened), and `reflection` (Bryan's account of what it meant). bob[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]is the only writer. A new intention card in the property-card [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]family (album, record, and bank cards) shows the fields at the top [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]of the note, and `==` edits them. The daily Headline, week [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Intentions, quarter Outcomes, and year Theme are migrated and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]retired. The morning ritual gains a PRE row that launches a summary[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent and a POST row that reflects on yesterday. The agent finds [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the summary instructions through bob, never through note text.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Intention fields contract, typed reader, YAML writer, and [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]readers[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]fields[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fields: add src/native/intentions/ with the day-or-period subject [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver, the typed frontmatter reader (intentions, summary, reflection,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and stamps) with a legacy fallback to the old body shapes, a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]line-preserving YAML writer that verifies by re-parsing, and one review [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state machine for days and periods. Rewire every reader to it: [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-pomodoros, periods show, list, parts, strip, and brief. Document[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the contract in docs/periods.md.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob periods update guarded envelope and day subjects in show[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]update[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fields[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]update: add `bob periods update <SUBJECT> -i FILE|-`, the guarded JSON [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]envelope the card editor writes through. It has intention, reflection, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and summary ops, a field fingerprint as `expect`, dry run, inverse_ops [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]for Undo, the vault lock, and atomic writes. Teach `bob periods show` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]day subjects, update help and docs, and run `just docs-gen`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Day brief, summary drafting, and brief-carried instructions[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]summary[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fields[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]summary: add the versioned day-summary instruction asset and day brief [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]v1. Every `bob periods brief` prints its instructions first. `bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]periods draft` writes a day's summary and splits a period draft into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]summary plus Review body. A reflection no longer blocks a first draft. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Bump the brief to v3 vocabulary, add the seven day summaries to the week[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]brief, and ship v3 callouts. Docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Link repair inside the owned keys and problems findings[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]repair[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fields[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]repair: make archive, task move/merge/split, ref rename, and every other[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vault link retargeting rewrite links inside intentions, summary, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reflection on daily and period notes exactly as they rewrite body links.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Restamp a drafted summary digest. Add the dangling_period_link, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]intentions_shape, intentions_over_soft_cap, and legacy_period_text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]findings to `bob periods list -p`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Migration step and scaffolds without the old sections[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]migrate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after fields, summary[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]migrate: add the intentions step to `bob periods migrate`. One [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dry-run-first, idempotent vault_rewrite moves the daily Headline and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Reflection, week Intentions, quarter Outcomes, year Theme + Outcomes, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`## Reflection`, and the Review opener into frontmatter. It reports [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]placeholders and conflicts. Scaffolds stop emitting the old sections. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Fixture-vault goldens mirror the live shapes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Property-card kit extracted from the album, record, and bank [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
      [bold #D7AFFF]cards[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]kit[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]kit: in bob-ledger-tools, extract the shared property-card kit with no [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]visible change: owned-key property hiding (generalized from the record [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]album|bank|record list, the host mount lifecycle, and shared [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]docs so "card" means the panel and "card editor" means what `==` opens.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Intention card, card editor, commands, and deploy[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]card[dim] · [dim][/dim]after kit, update[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]card: build the intention card on the kit (kicker, numbered intentions, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]SUMMARY with provenance, REFLECTION, recent-closed ghost line, parent [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]intentions line) and its `==` card editor (browse keys, one-line [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]intention stage, reflection textarea, reorder, remove, Undo, `=` climb, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`[`/`]` siblings, `y` YAML). Add palette and Command Mode rows, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]previews, and e2e. Deploy with `bob plugins sync`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt in the vault and chezmoi[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]Summarize yesterday and POST Reflect on yesterday rows. Set [/#D7D7AF]
